controls.name: Dependency vulnerability scanning

controls.name: Fail-closed enforcement
controls.impact: If not met: The default decision is allow, or an error in the policy path lets the action proceed.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: The default decision is deny and errors in the policy path deny the action.

controls.name: Policy enforced before action
controls.impact: If not met: A path executes the governed action without evaluating the policy, or the policy is only documented.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: The policy is evaluated in code before the governed action executes, on every path to that action.

controls.name: Controlled change path
controls.impact: If not met: Production can be deployed from an unprotected branch or without review.

controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Audit writes store codes, identifiers and hashes, not secrets or raw client-supplied text.
